properties.rationale: Standing disposition: validation evidence lives in docs/trials/ and in field reports from real use, not as validation-kind Verifications, so the detector correctly reports what the graph cannot see. Re-acknowledged at 52 capabilities — the gap id derives from the affected SET, so every new capability mints a new id and the previous acknowledgement cannot carry. That churn is a finding about the acknowledgement mechanism, not about validation.
